SELECT `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` AS free_rate
FROM frpm
JOIN schools ON frpm.CDSCode = schools.CDSCode
WHERE schools.SOCType = 'Continuation School'
  AND `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)` > 0
  AND `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY free_rate ASC
LIMIT 3
